## About
Craig's Auto Repair is a family owned business run by father and son. We work on all facets of auto repair, from check engine lights and brakes to engines, transmissions and smog checks.
We repair both import and domestic cars, and we work on fleet vehicles for many of the local businesses around Mission Hills. Our technicians are ASE certified and smog check certified.
Our goal is simple: a car that you and your family can count on for safe, reliable transportation. Customers tell us they come back because we are honest, we explain the work, and our prices are fair.

## Services
- Check engine light diagnosis and repair: We find out why the light is on and fix what is causing it.
- Brake repairs: Brake work to keep you stopping safely.
- Smog checks and smog failure repairs: Smog checks, plus repairs if your car does not pass.
- Engine work and replacements: From repairs to full engine replacement.
- Transmission repairs and replacement: Transmission repair, or replacement when it is needed.
- Air conditioning repairs: Get your A/C blowing cold again.
- Electrical diagnosis and repair: Starters, alternators and all kinds of electrical problems.
- Oil, fluids and flushes: Oil changes, fluid replacement and flushes to keep things running right.
- Timing belt replacement: Timing belt replacement as part of keeping your engine healthy.

## FAQ
Q: What makes of cars do you work on?
A: Import and domestic, including Toyota, Honda, Lexus, BMW, Mercedes, Volvo, Ford, Chevrolet and many more. We work on both electric and gasoline vehicles.

Q: How do I find the shop?
A: You can come in off Sepulveda Blvd just south of San Fernando Mission Blvd, across the street from Hamer Toyota, where we share a parking lot with the Vista Paint store. There is also a back entrance off Stranwood Ave.

Q: What are your weekday hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday from 7:30 to 5:30.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes, on Saturday from 8:00 to 1:00. We are closed on Sunday.
